lines:
المقطع يتتبع مهمة
للعثور على منبع النهر

قتال ضد وحوش ملعونة
بالقوس والسيف والسحر

headline: فيديو جديد من لعب Fable
label: نظرة أولى
showcase_reason: the news is the trailer itself: Fable's official quest gameplay video

angle.hook: Fable shows four minutes of its own quest gameplay, a work-in-progress PC build, with the Feb 23 date and a UAE price on Steam
angle.why_now: the official video came out on 12 Nov as part of Xbox's 25th anniversary, and Steam shows the UAE price and the language list
angle.what_it_means_here: the Steam UAE price is 269 AED and the Steam page lists no Arabic
angle.payoff: release 23 Feb 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC
